name: WF-248 — Final Closing Outcome → Verified Close, Profit Reconciliation & CRM Closeout

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const outcome=String(d.final_outcome_status??d.status??"").toLowerCase();const funding=Boolean(d.funding_confirmed??false),title=Boolean(d.title_confirmed??false);const closing_date=d.closing_date??d.actual_closing_date??null;const gross=Number(d.gross_profit??d.assignment_fee??NaN),costs=Number(d.closing_costs??d.total_costs??0);const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];let status="needs_review",reason="Verified close requires review.",next="WF-126",net=null;if(Number.isFinite(gross)&&Number.isFinite(costs))net=gross-costs;if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){status="blocked";reason="Missing lead, deal, or property identity.";}else if(blockers.length){status="blocked";reason="Unresolved closing blockers remain.";}else if(outcome!=="closing_outcome_ready"){status="outcome_not_ready";reason="Final closing outcome is not ready for verification.";next="WF-247";}else if(!funding||!title){status="close_verification_required";reason="Funding and title confirmation are required.";next="WF-247";}else if(!closing_date){status="close_verification_required";reason="Actual closing date is required.";next="WF-247";}else if(!Number.isFinite(gross)||!Number.isFinite(costs)||net===null){status="profit_inputs_invalid";reason="Gross profit or closing cost inputs are invalid.";next="WF-247";}else{status="verified_close";reason="Closing outcome, funding, title, date, and profit inputs are verified.";next="WF-249";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-248",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,outcome_status:outcome,funding_confirmed:funding,title_confirmed:title,closing_date,gross_profit:Number.isFinite(gross)?gross:null,closing_costs:Number.isFinite(costs)?costs:null,net_profit:net,close_status:status,reason,requires_human_review:status!=="verified_close",next_workflow:next}}];
